'''Naan''' is [[dough]] fired in a [[mud kiln]]. It heals {{Hp|4}} and has no other effect.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/kiln/naan.json}}</ref> It is a renamed piece of [[bread]], so it can be used in any recipe that calls for bread.

== Obtaining ==

=== Kilning ===
{{Recipes}}
Dough becomes naan in a mud kiln in 5 seconds. Picking up dough unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating naan takes 1.6 seconds and heals {{Hp|4}}. Unlike bread it doesn't remove harmful effects.

=== Crafting ingredient ===
Naan works as bread in [[bruschetta]], [[French toast]], [[honied French toast]], [[sweet berry toast]], [[latke]]s and [[ice cream]].
